_comment: Lockfile fixture for the license-clean calibration case. Carries the `license` field that
licenseFacts.resolvePackageLicense reads, so the case's deterministic backstop resolves
`commander` from THIS fixture rather than from ACR's own package-lock.json.
WHY it exists: license-clean asserts that a permissive dependency produces no compliance
finding, and the backstop that guarantees that resolves the package against the reviewed
project's metadata. With projectPath defaulting to process.cwd(), the reviewed project was ACR
itself -- the case only passed because `commander` happens to be a real dependency here, so it
was testing this repo's incidental dependency set rather than the mechanism. Dropping commander
from ACR would have silently turned this into a pure test of model recall, which is the exact
6/10-failing configuration the backstop was built to replace.
Unlike vulnerable-lockfile.json, the non-lockfile filename here is not about Dependabot (this
content is a single permissive package and raises no alerts) -- it is materializeFixtureProject's
uniform input convention, and keeps the two fixtures symmetric.
No `npm install` is required: resolvePackageLicense prefers the lockfile's own `license` field
over node_modules, so a lockfile-only fixture project resolves fully.
npm ignores unknown top-level keys, so this _comment block is inert.
name: acr-calibration-license-clean-fixture
